alternative_flow.content: If the distributor or salesman name is not available in the system, then the system has a provision to navigate quickly to its master screen and enter the new Distributor and Salesman details, without closing the present screen.

While entering the No of vouchers required, the system should automatically pick the Batch No’s with voucher No’s from the available voucher stock and list the details of each voucher with below information’s as a grid format.

exception_flow.content: If the distributor or salesman name is not available in the system during transaction entry, the system shall provide a provision to navigate quickly to its master screen and enter the new Distributor and Salesman details without closing the present screen. The user must complete this navigation and data entry before proceeding with the distribution transaction.

If the system detects a duplicate ID for a distributor or salesman during master record creation or selection, it shall display a warning message prompting the user to change the name or use a differentiating indicator. The transaction cannot proceed until a unique identifier is provided.

If the 'Required Qty' (number of vouchers required by the distributor) exceeds the available voucher stock, the system shall prevent the transaction from being completed. The user must adjust the quantity or wait for additional voucher batches to be created and allocated.

If mandatory fields (e.g., Name of distributor, Name of Sales Man, Date of Distribution, Required Qty, Invoice Amount) are left blank during the distribution transaction, the system shall validate the form upon save attempt and reject the transaction, displaying an error indicating which mandatory information is missing.

parsed.goal: To record the details of voucher distribution from the VMU to distributors, including capturing distributor and sales team information, allocating vouchers, and generating invoices.

main_flow.content: The VMU User selects the 'Distribution Transactions' module.
The system prompts the user to select a Distributor from the Distributor Master list.
The VMU User selects a Salesman from the Sales Team Master list.
The VMU User enters the Date of Distribution.
The VMU User enters the Required Quantity (number of vouchers required by the distributor).
The system automatically allocates relevant voucher numbers and batch numbers based on available stock.
The system calculates the Invoice Amount as: Number of vouchers x Wholesale price.
The VMU User confirms the Mode of Payment (e.g., Cash).
The system generates an auto-generated Distribution Invoice Number.
The system saves the transaction details, updating the distributor's sales history and reducing the available voucher stock.

postconditions.content: The system has captured the details of voucher sales between MISU sales team and Distributors.
The system has recorded distributor-wise, salesman-wise, and batch number-wise sales details for reporting purposes.
An auto-generated Distribution Invoice Number has been created by the system.
The invoice amount has been calculated automatically based on the wholesale sale rate and quantity sold.
The mode of payment (Cash) has been recorded for the transaction.
The available voucher stock has been updated to reflect the distributed vouchers.

claims.content: The VMU has created vouchers with unique identification numbers, security protocols, and bar-codes.
Distributor Master Information (including Distributor Code, Name, Address, etc.) has been captured in the system.
MSIU Sales Team Information (including Salesman Code, Name, etc.) has been captured in the system.
The VMU User is logged into the system with appropriate privileges to perform distribution transactions.

parsed.trigger: The VMU User initiates a distribution transaction to sell vouchers to a distributor.
